purpose: Define controlled spectral-power-distribution evidence and independent colour-quality calculations without promoting synthetic data or an older software method to current product authority.

standardsReferences.note: CIE states that Ra remains current during transition and encourages parallel reporting with the newer CIE fidelity index.
Current product TM-30 authority. An older open-source implementation must not be represented as TM-30-24 compliance.
Current IES reference for CCT and distance from the Planckian locus. Independent software calculations are cross-checks unless the released method is demonstrated equivalent.

supportedCalculationsUsed: CIE 1995 CRI Ra and special indices
softwareToolchain.knownAuthorityLimit: colour-science 0.4.7 exposes ANSI/IES TM-30-18, not TM-30-24. TM-30-18 results are independent compatibility checks only.

requiredProductEvidence: measurement date and instrument/report reference where available
current TM-30-24 supplier/lab/IES-tool report or equivalent controlled primary evidence
independent calculation report from repository toolchain
rules: Synthetic blackbody or other generated SPD data is test-only and can never close a product evidence gate.
TM-30-18 calculations from colour-science must never be labelled TM-30-24 results.
Published CRI/CCT marketing values do not replace controlled raw SPD and exact configuration provenance.
A successful spectral software workflow is not certification and does not approve the final head family.
No TM-30 threshold is invented before the product colour-quality specification is released.
Product photometry remains conceptual until exact angular photometry and exact spectral evidence are both controlled.
